title: One Fungus Erased 90 Frog Species
hook: Extinction was rare—then one fungus erased 90 frog species.
closing: One disease changed amphibian survival worldwide, and recovery remains uncommon.
question: Which frog species would you save?

segments.say: The fungus affected 501 frog and salamander species, turning one pathogen into a global amphibian crisis.
Still-declining species make up 39 percent of those affected, so the damage continues after detection.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species, proving even isolated ecosystems were not protected.
